Composition rights
Original composition is public domain in the United States and ordinary life-plus-70 jurisdictions. Inferred, not documented

No. 3 was first published in 1857; Schubert died in 1828. Modern editions are a separate rights question.

Recording rights
Rule 1 — recording licence/release: CC BY 3.0 Unported. Documented

Commons explicitly applies cc-by-3.0 to Chiara Bertoglio’s recording and identifies the performer as author. The 20 December 2012 item/submission date is not treated as a session date.
